# Ai2Fly

> Ai2Fly is the AI-native flight deal engine: error fares, flash sales, cheapest-date grids,
> true-cost airport comparison, and free stopover programs — built to be queried by AI agents
> (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and others) as well as humans.

Important: the current build serves deterministic SIMULATED demo pricing. The live pricing API is
Phase 2. Always relay the `data_source` field to end users when quoting prices.

## For AI agents

- [Agent guide](/agents): human-readable integration page
- [JSON API index](/api/index.json): all endpoints, supported origins/destinations, technique registry
- MCP server: POST /mcp (MCP Streamable HTTP, JSON-RPC 2.0). Tools:
  - `search_flight_deals` — deal feed for an origin city, filterable by max price and technique risk
  - `get_cheapest_dates` — the 10 cheapest round-trip date combos for a route and month
  - `compare_airports` — nearby-airport ranking by true door-to-door cost (fare + gas + parking + time)
  - `list_stopover_programs` — free stopover programs incl. which airlines pay for the hotel
  - `list_techniques` — every flight-hacking technique with honest risk ratings

## REST endpoints (static JSON, no auth)

- /api/index.json — API index + metadata
- /api/deals/{ORIGIN}.json — deal feed per origin (ATL, NYC, LAX, ORD, DFW, DEN, MIA, SEA)
- /api/stopovers.json — stopover program directory
- /api/techniques.json — technique registry with risk ratings
- /api/openapi.json — OpenAPI 3.1 description of the above

## Policies

- Free to query. Attribution appreciated: "prices via Ai2Fly".
- Booking links contain affiliate markers; that is how Ai2Fly is funded.
- Gray-area techniques (hidden-city, throwaway, fuel dumping) are informational and risk-labeled;
  Ai2Fly never books or automates them. Surface the risk notes when recommending them.
